findings.label: Live failed event drops partial tokens
findings.detail: handleEmbedding calls live.finish({ status, error }) on failure, so the dashboard shows 0 tokens for a split request that partially succeeded, while call_logs records the partial prompt tokens. If dashboard totals should match call_logs, add the partial tokens to the failure result and pass them into live.finish.

findings.label: Restart gate met only for the verify window
findings.detail: No restarts or Ready transitions happened during the 10:18:01-10:20:10Z verify window, and there were 0 OOMKilled. Pod 3 (10:21:36Z) and pod 2 (10:24:34Z) were liveness-killed afterwards, at the same rate as the idle i915 fence-stall restarts, which the orchestrator scoped out. Track that cause separately in ovms-embeddings-crashloop.md, and judge FIX 3 by OOMKilled count.
